citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.
Aseptic processing areas are deficient regarding the system for cleaning and disinfecting the room to produce aseptic conditions.
Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile are not written.

citations.short: Validation lacking for sterile drug products
citations.long: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile do not include validation of the sterilization process.

Laboratory controls do not include the establishment of scientifically sound and appropriate test procedures designed to assure that in-process materials conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality and purity.
Written records are not made of investigations into unexplained discrepancies and the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications.
Aseptic processing areas are deficient regarding temperature controls.
Equipment used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drug products is not of appropriate design, of adequate size, and suitably located to facilitate operations for its intended use.

citations.short: Validation lacking for sterile drug products
citations.long: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile do not include validation of the sterilization process.

citations.short: Label storage access limited to authorized personnel
citations.long: Access to the storage area for labels and labeling materials is not limited to authorized personnel.
Labels and other labeling materials are not stored separately with suitable identification for each different drug product, strength, dosage form or quantity of contents.

citations.short: Strict control not exercised over labeling issued
citations.long: Strict control is not exercised over labeling issued for use in drug product labeling operations.

citations.short: Drug products - samples representative, identified properly
citations.long: Samples taken of drug products for determination of conformance to written specifications are not representative and properly identified.
Written records of investigations into the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications do not always include the conclusions and follow-up.

Written procedures for cleaning and maintenance fail to include maintenance and cleaning schedules, description in sufficient detail of methods, equipment and materials used, description in sufficient detail of the methods of disassembling and reassembling equipment as necessary to assure proper cleaning and maintenance, and instructions for removal or obliteration of previous batch identification.
Established laboratory control mechanisms are not followed and documented at the time of performance.
The establishment of specifications and test procedures including any changes thereto, are not drafted by the appropriate organizational unit and reviewed and approved by the quality control unit.
